ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (19) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

Attributions follow the print, surnames only where only surnames are given: «Кетлэ» (Ketle) is Quetelet and «Фламмарион» (Flammarion) Flammarion; «царство зла» (tsarstvo zla) is 'the kingdom of evil', matching «царство» (tsarstvo, 'kingdom') elsewhere. «Власть» (vlast') is 'power' in the closing thought.
Source observation: [13] this paragraph, plainly continuing Flammarion ('this strange planet'), is printed after the attribution «Фламмарион.» and outside the quotation; translated as printed
